title: Estimated residential population density
dataset: WorldPop G2 R2025A v1, constrained, UN-adjusted, 30 arcseconds
attribution: Bondarenko et al. (2025), WorldPop, University of Southampton
processing: Cropped and mosaicked national count grids (sum at overlaps), divided by spherical cell area at each latitude; density rounded to 0.1 in the downloadable grid. No interpolation or artificial city kernels.
limitations: Modeled residential population, not live occupancy, individual homes, daytime crowds or a casualty estimate. A zero estimate does not establish that no people are present.
